title: Ripple Enables AI Agent Autonomous Payments for 25% of XRPL Activity
summary:
Automated programs are now capable of managing digital assets on the XRP Ledger via a technical rollout from Privy. This integration allows software agents to autonomously hold and spend XRP and the RLUSD stablecoin, extending the utility of the network's embedded wallet system beyond human-operated interfaces.

Payments initiated by these agents already account for 25% of all activity on the XRP Ledger. By leveraging the infrastructure from the Stripe-owned firm, developers can implement wallet functionality directly into their applications without building the backend systems required to support crypto holdings.
